# Joshua Werlein

> Software Engineer, Backend & Cloud Systems, based in Mondovi, Wisconsin. Builds production APIs, automation, and secure web platforms. Open to remote opportunities.

I hold a B.S. in Software Engineering from Western Governors University and work across the full stack — TypeScript and React on the frontend, Cloudflare Workers with D1, KV, and R2 for edge platforms, and Java for native Android applications.

- [Selected Work](https://joshuawerlein.com/#work): Three featured case studies (Grayz'n Buffalo, Friends of Lake Henry, KIL Construction) plus a secondary grid of additional projects.

## Featured Projects

- [Grayz'n Buffalo Bar & Grill](https://grayznbuffalo.com): Astro 7 and Cloudflare restaurant platform with D1 menus and specials, KV sessions, and R2 media. A scheduled Worker uses the Meta Graph API and Workers AI to extract poster specials, verifies source evidence, and uses guarded D1 writes. Newer verified posts can update earlier staff edits. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/grayzn-buffalo](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/grayzn-buffalo).

- [Friends of Lake Henry](https://friendsoflakehenry.com): Astro and Cloudflare nonprofit platform for raffle operations, donor listings, and moderated community photos. Dedicated Facebook Live and winner-photo Workers verify sources and route uncertain winner rows to admin review. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/friends-of-lake-henry](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/friends-of-lake-henry).

- [KIL Construction](https://kilcon.work): Astro and Cloudflare platform with signed admin sessions, public R2 galleries, private review uploads, and review moderation. The repository includes the gallery/reviews and contact Workers and signature-verified Meta new-post import tooling. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/kilConstruction](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/kilConstruction).

## More Work

- [Best By Manager](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bestbymanager.app): Published Android inventory app for shared-device retail and food-service workflows. Uses Room/SQLite, ZXing barcode scanning, local expiration alerts, and Owner/Admin/Employee access controls with biometric and PIN authentication. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/BestByManager](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/BestByManager).

- [Arkham Enterprises](https://www.arkhamsolar.com): Live production marketing and lead-gen site for a solar and construction company. React SPA served from a Cloudflare Worker with multi-step quote-request forms, Resend delivery, deep-linked service context, structured metadata, and accessibility-focused routing. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/arkham-solar](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/arkham-solar).

- [Blair Sportsmen's Club](https://blairsportsmensclub.com): Event and reservation platform with a D1-backed availability calendar, reservation requests, and trap-league scoring.
